Game Overview

In Penguino, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a frosty adventure with Penguino. Leap and glide across icy terrains, grabbing fish to satisfy your hunger and boost your score. Master tricky combos, dodge perilous waters and orcas, and snag power-ups from presents. Time is of the essence as ice melts beneath your feet!
